_note: Hand-written cook builds. Every build flips what its champion is known for (Nico, 2026-10-16: keep only builds like Melee Bomb Man Ziggs). build_data.py adds augment text, China win rates and simulator numbers and writes data.js. The first `core` augments decide the build's tier; the rest are flex picks. `augment_text` replaces the generated text for augments whose tooltip numbers the game data doesn't fill in.

augment_text.With Haste: Gain Move Speed equal to a share of your Ability Haste.
augment_text.Overloaded: Using another Ability resets the cooldown of the chosen ability.

builds.title: Melee Bomb Man
builds.why: Ziggs gives up his bombs-from-a-mile-away identity and walks up to stab people. Draw Your Sword turns his range into AD, Health, Attack Speed and Lifesteal, and his passive Short Fuse still blows up on his next melee hit. Dual Wield, Firebrand and Juiced pile on-hit magic damage onto every swing.
builds.play: Walk at them. Throw a bomb only when you're already standing on them.

builds.title: Noxian Sniper
builds.why: The reverse of Melee Bomb Man. Melee champions get more from the range augments than ranged ones (75, 150 and 250), so all three together add 475 range and put Darius's autos at 650, the same as Caitlyn's. He stacks Hemorrhage from across the fight, and Typhoon fires a second shot at another target.
builds.play: Stand at the back and auto. Walk up only to Guillotine whoever has five stacks.

builds.title: Tiny Marksman
builds.why: Veigar's whole game is stacking infinite Ability Power. escAPADe turns every point of it into 0.6 bonus AD (plus 15% more AD), so his Q stacks and even Rabadon's Deathcap now feed his auto attacks. Dual Wield, Critical Rhythm and It's Critical make him a crit marksman with a yordle hat.
builds.play: Farm Q stacks like normal, then right-click everyone. Cage still works.

builds.title: Global On-Hit
builds.why: Ethereal Weapon makes abilities apply on-hit effects, and Requiem hits every enemy champion on the map. So one R procs BotRK, Kraken Slayer, Wit's End, Nashor's, Juiced and a stack of Firebrand's burn on all five at once, from your fountain. Jeweled Gauntlet lets Requiem crit too.
builds.play: Buy marksman items on a mage. Press R from anywhere.

builds.title: Blizzard Engine
builds.why: Glacial Storm damages everyone inside it over and over. With Ethereal Weapon each enemy in the storm triggers your on-hit effects once a second, and Mystic Punch turns every on-hit into 1.25 seconds off your cooldowns. Three enemies in the storm should take almost four seconds off Q and E every second, so Flash Frost and Frostbite never stop.
builds.play: Drop R on their team and keep throwing Q and E into it.

builds.title: Critical Shrooms
builds.why: Vulnerability lets damage over time and item effects crit. Teemo's whole kit is damage over time, so every tick of Toxic Shot, every shroom and every Liandry's and Nashor's proc can crit. It's Critical and Zealot stack the crit chance, so the shrooms crit too.
builds.play: Plant shrooms, watch the yellow numbers.

builds.title: Yordle Bowling
builds.why: Buster Shot knocks its target back a long way. Fey Magic turns the target into a critter first, and Chain Reaction makes it a bowling ball: when the knocked-back champion hits another champion, both get knocked up and take damage, and hitting a wall knocks them up even longer.
builds.play: Line up a critter with their team, or with a wall, and R.

builds.title: Hook Storm
builds.why: With these on Rocket Grab, Overloaded resets the hook every time you use W, E or R, and Echo Cast sends a clone that fires a second hook. Spell Split then breaks each hook into two when it hits or reaches max range. That's up to four grabs flying out per hook.
builds.play: Q, E, Q, W, Q, R, Q. Somebody is getting pulled.

builds.title: Critter Rocket
builds.why: Super Mega Death Rocket crosses the whole map, and Fey Magic turns everyone it hits into a critter. Ultimate Revolution gives a second rocket right after the first and Ult Bot puts all your haste into R, so you fire map-wide polymorphs on a short cooldown. Can't Touch This makes you invulnerable each time you fire.
builds.play: Watch the minimap and snipe whoever is about to escape.
